content:
Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that its former employees stole trade secrets "for OpenAI's benefit."

Reportedly, in the process, Apple has directly contacted several former employees who now work at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued evidence preservation letters to approximately 40 former employees.

An evidence preservation letter is a formal written notice sent to individuals or organisations requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. Such letters typically specify the particular materials to be preserved.

This move stems from Apple's suspicion that the theft of trade secrets may extend beyond the scope identified when the lawsuit was first filed last week.

It is worth noting that Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products, along with former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan, as defendants.
